Name: BULLET_CREATE_LIMIT_PARAM_ST
Description: Caps on how many bullets of one group can exist at once. A bullet or spell joins a group through its Create Limit Group ID (Bullet, Magic), which is the row ID here; group 0 is never limited.

Fields.Name: Max Bullets in Group
Fields.Description: Most bullets of this group that can exist at once. When a bullet of the group is created with the cap reached, the oldest one (with its child bullets) is ended to make room. A spell whose Create Limit Group is at the cap can't be cast.

Fields.Name: Limit Per Owner
Fields.Description: If on, the cap counts only the bullets of this group fired by the same owner, and the oldest of the owner's bullets is the one ended. If off, every bullet of the group counts, whoever fired it. Retail: on for every row except 0.
